newsitem.title: USA: US high-yld fund inflows $627.6 mln in latest week.
newsitem.headline: US high-yld fund inflows $627.6 mln in latest week.

text.p: Net cash inflows to U.S. high-yield mutual funds totaled $627.6 million in the week ended June 11, AMG Data Services reported Thursday.
The number compares with inflows of $374 million in the week ended June 4, and a negative, albeit slight, reading one week earlier.

Market players have pointed to inflows as the primary engine behind price gains, especially for dozens of new issues, in the past several weeks. The cash influx has amounted to more than $4 billion since the market's short-lived correction in mid-March and early April.
The AMG numbers are tallied from high-yield bond funds that report on a weekly basis. They exclude reinvested distributions.
AMG, based in Arcata, Calif., is a U.S. mutual fund information company.
